title: From Planning to Resupply: US Army Expands AI Logistics With $99M Deal | Rune Technologies News
summary: Rune Technologies secured a $99 million five-year Army contract to deploy TyrOS, an AI platform that enhances military logistics planning and sustainment operations across deployed units.
body_markdown:
Military AI covered Rune Technologies by Samantha Alexa in a piece titled “From Planning to Resupply: US Army Expands AI Logistics With $99M Deal.” Rune Technologies secured a $99 million five-year Army contract to deploy TyrOS, an AI platform that enhances military logistics planning and sustainment operations across deployed units.


Read the full article[here](https://militaryai.ai/us-army-ai-logistics-rune-tyros/) .
